original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚倡导者呼吁采取更有力行动终结童婚
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚性暴力与性别暴力倡导者乔伊斯·哈鲁纳在洛科贾发表讲话，呼吁采取更有力措施终结童婚、保护女童权利。她呼吁家长、社区和宗教领袖以及政府加强儿童保护法执法、增加女童教育投入并追究侵权者责任。该消息由尼日利亚通讯社报道，属单一来源。

key_facts.fact: 倡导者乔伊斯·哈鲁纳在洛科贾呼吁采取更有力措施终结童婚
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Ms Joyce Haruna, a sexual and gender -based violence advocate, has called for a stronger measures to end child marriage and safeguard the rights and future of the girl child.

key_facts.fact: 她呼吁政府加强儿童保护法执法并增加女童教育投入
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: She also called on governments to strengthen the enforcement of child protection laws, increase investment in girls’ education, support vulnerable families and establish effective channels for reporting abuse.

key_facts.fact: 该呼吁是在2026年国际女童日之际发出的
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Haruna made the call in Lokoja on Tuesday in a message marking the 2026 International Day of the Girl Child

uncertainties: 该报道为单一来源，尚未获得其他来源交叉验证
